title: Conversas of a work account with people
summary: Conversas of a work account with two or more people (bipe ADR 0284 phase A): filters Comigo, Sem ninguém and Todas, and who has each chat. With one person nothing changes.

filter.description: mine: assignee_seat_id is my seat. pool: no record, or assignee_seat_id null. all: every chat. Default all.

people.description: Number of active seats from GET /v1/me/business/seats. The filters and assignee lines show only at 2 or more.

of.description: Room ID and seat name pairs from GET /v1/me/business/chats and the seat list.

assignees.description: Who has each chat, for the row line.

load.effect: GET /v1/me/business/chats and GET /v1/me/business/seats when Conversas opens and when the app comes to the front.

selectFilter.effect: Filters the chat list on the device. No call.

notes: Only customer chats of the work account have records. Anotações, the drafts room and the notes room never show in the filters.
A row shows bipe_chat_assignee_me, bipe_chat_assignee_other with the seat name, or nothing for the pool.
